# wire_golden_vectors.txt -- sprint 124 ticket 004 (SUC-002, REQUIRED,
# non-negotiable): THE shared cross-language golden-vector fixture for the
# protocol v5 COBS(delimiter=0x0A) + CRC-scope wire composition (issue
# protocol-v5-one-line-packets-command-prefix-and-newline-cobs.md, section 2
# "COBS against 0x0A" / section 3 "CRC scope" / section 5 "Worked example").
#
# ONE file, read by BOTH:
#   - src/tests/sim/unit/wire_golden_vector_harness.cpp (C++, via
#     src/tests/sim/unit/test_wire_golden_vectors.py's compile+run wrapper)
#   - src/tests/unit/test_wire_golden_vectors.py (pytest, direct read)
#
# DO NOT hand-copy these vectors, or new ones, into either language's own
# test source. That is exactly the defect class this ticket exists to
# close: sprint 123 shipped a 0x0A-in-binary-frame corruption (fixed
# narrowly in 123-006) because firmware's and host's demuxers were two
# independent guesses with no shared vector forcing them to agree. If you
# need a new vector, add a row here and both suites pick it up automatically.
#
# --- Composition each row's expected_wire_hex encodes -----------------------
#
#   crc     = crc16_ccitt_false(command ? command + ":" + payload : payload)
#   combined = payload || crc16_le(crc)          (crc appended, little-endian)
#   expected_wire = cobsEncode(combined, delimiter)
#
# This is the primitive-level composition WireRuntime::cobsEncode()/
# crcInit()+crcUpdate() (firmware) and cobs_encode()/crc16_init()+
# crc16_update() (host, wire_codec.py) already implement -- see
# comms.cpp's crcOverScope() / wire_codec.py's _crc_over_scope() for the
# production functions this mirrors. NOTE: as of ticket 003, delimiter=0x0A
# and the command CRC-scope are NOT yet wired into Comms::sendReply()/
# encode_frame() themselves (both still default to delimiter=0x00, no
# command scope) -- that cutover is ticket 124-005's "framing grammar"
# scope. This fixture exercises the underlying WireRuntime/wire_codec
# PRIMITIVES directly, at the exact composition ticket 005 will wire in,
# so the codecs are proven to agree BEFORE that cutover lands.
#
# --- Provenance (source column) ---------------------------------------------
#
#   issue_section2_table         -- byte-for-byte from the issue's own
#                                    hand-verified §2 adversarial-input table.
#   issue_section5_worked_example -- byte-for-byte from the issue's own
#                                    hand-verified §5 worked MOVE example.
#   clean_room_reference          -- computed by a clean-room reference
#                                    script (independent of BOTH
#                                    wire_runtime.cpp and wire_codec.py --
#                                    a fresh textbook COBS + CRC-16/CCITT-
#                                    FALSE implementation) whose output was
#                                    first cross-validated against every
#                                    issue_section*-sourced row above before
#                                    being trusted to generate these. See
#                                    ticket 124-004's completion notes for
#                                    the generation script.
#
# --- Columns (pipe-delimited; '#'-prefixed and blank lines ignored) --------
#
#   name | delimiter_hex | command | payload_hex | expected_wire_hex | source
#
# name           -- unique identifier, used as the test id on both sides.
# delimiter_hex  -- the COBS delimiter byte, 2 hex chars (always "0a" today).
# command        -- ASCII command name the CRC is scoped over, or empty for
#                    no scope extension (crc16(payload) alone).
# payload_hex    -- the payload bytes, hex-encoded (empty string = 0 bytes).
# expected_wire_hex -- the full expected COBS-encoded wire bytes, hex-encoded.
# source         -- provenance, see above.
name|delimiter_hex|command|payload_hex|expected_wire_hex|source
all_0x0a|0a||0a0a0a0a0a0a0a0a|0100000000000000004178|issue_section2_table
all_0x00|0a||0000000000000000|0b0b0b0b0b0b0b0b09343b|issue_section2_table
sweep_0x00_0x0f|0a||000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f|0b180b08090e0f0c0d02030001060704053d31|issue_section2_table
empty_payload|0a|||09f5f5|clean_room_reference
sweep_0x00_0xff|0a||||clean_room_reference
crc_scope_move|0a|MOVE|08071a00220300410a|0e020d100928090f4b00d309|issue_section5_worked_example
crc_scope_stop_same_payload|0a|STOP|08071a00220300410a|0e020d100928090f4b00dd0e|clean_room_reference
payload_contains_colon_and_zero|0a||666f6f3a6261720062617a|026c656530686b780c686b70a0e9|clean_room_reference
